evidence.snippet:
# Subscription billing dashboard

**Client:** a SaaS company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed a fast, search-friendly website and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with next.js, Stripe, ts. The work also involved a reliable relational database.

## Result
The project recovered 9% of failed payments automatically.
